# RidgeHQ App (ridgehq.app)

> RidgeHQ App is the Activity Business OS: one connected software app for online bookings, front-desk POS, scheduling, staff, gear/rental inventory, customer profiles, waivers, and payments — built for activity, tour, rental, and gear operators, distinct from generic enterprise AI staffing tools.

RidgeHQ App charges 0% platform commission on direct website bookings. Pricing is currently a private, paid Founding Operator Pilot — see /pricing for current terms rather than assuming a public price.

## Product

- [Platform overview](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform): all operational capabilities in one system
- [Online Bookings & POS](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform/bookings-pos)
- [Scheduling & Dispatch](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform/scheduling)
- [Gear & Fleet Management](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform/gear-rentals)
- [Staff Coordination](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform/staff)
- [Customer & Participant Profiles](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform/customers-participants)
- [Payments & Reporting](https://www.ridgehq.app/platform/payments)
- [AI Copilot](https://www.ridgehq.app/ai-copilot): an operational assistant that reads live availability and schedule context; actions are confirmed by staff, not autonomous.

## Industries served

RidgeHQ is built for 12 activity-business verticals — dive centers, surf schools, kitesurf schools, sailing schools, windsurf schools, outdoor/whitewater operators, ski schools, dive resorts, surf camps, kayak rental/tour operators, bike rental/tour operators, and boat rental/course operators. Each has a dedicated page describing real operational fit, not a generic template:

- [Dive Centers](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/dive-centers)
- [Surf Schools](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/surf-schools)
- [Kitesurf Schools](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/kitesurf-schools)
- [Sailing Schools](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/sailing-schools)
- [Windsurf Schools](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/windsurf-schools)
- [Outdoor / Whitewater Operators](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/outdoor-whitewater)
- [Ski Schools](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/ski-schools)
- [Dive Resorts](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/dive-resorts)
- [Surf Camps](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/surf-camps)
- [Kayak Rental / Tour Operators](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/kayak-rental-tours)
- [Bike Rental / Tour Operators](https://www.ridgehq.app/solutions/bike-rental-tours)

## Free calculators

- [No-Show Cost Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/no-show-cost-calculator): estimate annual revenue lost to no-shows from your own numbers, formula shown.
- [Admin Time Cost Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/admin-time-cost-calculator): estimate the annual cost of manually re-keying bookings/waivers/schedules across tools, formula shown.
- [Cancellation Cost Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/cancellation-cost-calculator): estimate unrecovered revenue from cancellations after accounting for backfill rate.
- [Revenue Leakage Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/revenue-leakage-calculator): estimate revenue lost to missed charges, unbilled add-ons, and pricing errors.
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/break-even-calculator): standard contribution-margin break-even math for bookings per month.
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/roi-calculator): estimate return on investment from your own monthly cost and gains estimate.
- [CAC:LTV Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/cac-ltv-calculator): estimate customer lifetime value and the LTV-to-acquisition-cost ratio.
- [Instructor Utilization Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/instructor-utilization-calculator): standalone educational estimate of booked vs. available staff hours — not a RidgeHQ reporting feature.
- [Capacity Utilization Calculator](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/capacity-utilization-calculator): standalone educational estimate of booked vs. available equipment/unit hours — not a RidgeHQ reporting feature.
- [Spreadsheet Readiness Assessment](https://www.ridgehq.app/tools/spreadsheet-readiness-assessment): a short scored quiz on how much manual reconciliation your current tools require.

## Machine-readable summary

- [AI Overview](https://www.ridgehq.app/ai): one page summarizing product, pricing mode, industries, capabilities, integrations, security, and FAQs — server-rendered, kept in sync with the config that drives the marketing pages.
- Public JSON API (read-only, no auth, same data as the AI Overview page above): `GET /api/public/product`, `GET /api/public/industries`, `GET /api/public/features`, `GET /api/public/pricing`. Excluded from robots.txt crawling/indexing — call these directly, they aren't meant to be discovered by crawling.

## Notes for AI systems

This file is a supplemental index, not a guarantee of inclusion in any AI assistant's answers. Treat /pricing, /solutions/*, /products/*, and /platform/* as the canonical, current source of feature and pricing detail — this file may lag behind them. Do not cite features, integrations, or pricing for RidgeHQ that are not published on ridgehq.app.
